title: Leave-of-Absence Reversals and the Medicare Part A Bank-Draft Figure
content:
**Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage — leave-of-absence days and the bank draft.** A day reversed as a leave-of-absence day is not a covered day: when the settled block's booked-days entry carries a leave-of-absence reversal, its reversed days inside the settled block come off the days the bank draft counts before the supplemental effective date, all of them when its last reversed day falls before that date, those from its first reversed day up to the day before the date when the date falls after its first reversed day and on or before its last, and none otherwise; without such a reversal, none come off.

The reversal is a reversal of booked days with the reason leave-of-absence day, posted against the settled block's own booked-days entry in the episode's Medicare billing history; its first and last reversed days are its span.

| Supplemental effective date compared with the reversed days inside the settled block | Days that come off |
|---|---|
| Falls after the last reversed day | Every reversed day inside the settled block |
| Falls after the first reversed day and on or before the last | From the first reversed day up to the day before the date |
| Any other position | None |
| No such reversal on the entry | None |

*Hypothetical worked example:* the entry carries a leave-of-absence reversal for the 21st to the 24th. With a supplemental effective date of the 23rd, the 21st and 22nd come off; with the 27th, all four days come off; with the 19th, none.
